Welcome to the FAMU CoPPS, IPH!
As Florida A&M University's College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute
of Public Health, we are marking 75 years since our founding in 1951 as the nation's
only College of Pharmacy home to a fully accredited Institute of Public Health. This
milestone honors 75 years of preparing pharmacists, scientists and public health leaders
who transform lives across our communities.
FAMU CoPPS, IPH Welcomes Dr. Vanessa Sheppard!
The FAMU College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute of Public Health
is proud to welcome Dr. Vanessa B. Sheppard as our new dean, effective August 3, 2026.
Dr. Sheppard will also serve as assistant vice president for Health Science Enterprise
and Research Innovation.

Program Data
Caption: The program is the first BSPS program at an accredited HBCU College of Pharmacy in
the nation and the first undergraduate BSPS program in Florida. The program was established
in 2017, has 30 graduates to date, and offers more than five career pathways. Graduate
pathways include medical school, physician assistant programs, the pharmaceutical
industry, and graduate programs.
Contact Dr. Tiffany Ardley tiffany.ardley@famu.edu, 850-599-3774 for more information.

The Florida A&M University College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute
of Public Health program offers its learners PharmD, BS, MS, PhD, MPH and DrPH degrees.
With its main campus in Tallahassee, Florida, it is the only pharmacy program in the
United States with a fully accredited Institute of Public Health. The College has
additional practice centers in Jacksonville, Davie, and Tampa with a campus in Crestview,
which support the infrastructure for the College's statewide commitment to pharmacy
and public health education through research, teaching, and community service.

Dr. Johnnie L. Early II Honored with AACP 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award
The American Association of Colleges of Pharmacy (AACP) has bestowed its prestigious
2026 Lifetime Achievement Award upon Johnnie L. Early II, Ph.D., R.Ph., FNPhA, of
Florida A&M University (FAMU). The national honor recognizes Dr. Early’s lifelong
commitment and extraordinary contributions to advancing pharmacy education, research,
and professional leadership.
FAMU Researcher Albert Ngo Receives National Early-Stage Investigator Award
Florida A&M University researcher Albert Nguessan Ngo, Ph.D., has received the 2026
Sidney A. McNairy Jr. Early-Stage Investigator Award for Inclusive Excellence for
his work on a targeted nanomedicine approach to prostate cancer treatment.
FAMU CoPPS, IPH Welcomes Dr. Vanessa Sheppard!
The FAMU College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute of Public Health
is proud to welcome Dr. Vanessa B. Sheppard as our new dean, effective August 3, 2026.
Dr. Sheppard will also serve as assistant vice president for Health Science Enterprise
and Research Innovation.
FAMU Pharmacy Alumni, Students Reflect on 56th NDPAC Convention
Florida A&M University College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences (FAMU CoPPS)
students and alumni returned from the 56th National Pharmaceutical Association (NPhA)
Convention in Atlanta with new professional connections, career insights and a renewed
sense of purpose.
CoPPS, IPH Scholars are FAMU’s Finest
Journey Magazine recently presented “FAMU’s Finest”, where the student led magazine
recognized one male and one female scholar from each school or college at Florida
A&M University. The magazine recognizes scholar’s academic achievements, campus involvement,
and leadership. The process of selection began with nominations being submitted through
Journey Magazine’s Instagram page, after being nominated the students received an
application to formally apply.
